name: iot-streaming-pubsub-to-bq-with-dlq
description: Streaming pipeline: Pub/Sub → BigQuery (raw) + DLQ (BigQuery + optional GCS) + optional Firestore. DLQ to GCS uses windowing to be streaming-safe.

parameters.name: input_topic
parameters.label: Input Pub/Sub Topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic to read from. Format: projects/<project>/topics/<topic>

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: BigQuery Output Table (Raw)
parameters.helpText: BigQuery table for valid events. Format: project:dataset.table

parameters.name: dlq_table
parameters.label: BigQuery DLQ Table
parameters.helpText: BigQuery table for dead-letter records. Format: project:dataset.table

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.label: GCP Project ID
parameters.helpText: Project ID used by Firestore client.

parameters.name: enable_firestore
parameters.label: Enable Firestore Sink
parameters.helpText: Whether to write latest sensor state to Firestore. Use true or false.

parameters.name: firestore_collection
parameters.label: Firestore Collection
parameters.helpText: Firestore collection name for sensor state.

parameters.name: deadletter_path
parameters.label: GCS DLQ File Prefix (optional)
parameters.helpText: GCS file prefix for DLQ files (JSONL). Example: gs://<bucket>/dataflow/dlq/iot_readings_dlq . Leave empty to disable GCS DLQ.

parameters.name: deadletter_window_sec
parameters.label: DLQ GCS Window Size (seconds)
parameters.helpText: Fixed window size in seconds for DLQ files written to GCS.

parameters.name: deadletter_trigger_sec
parameters.label: DLQ GCS Trigger Delay (seconds)
parameters.helpText: Processing-time trigger delay (seconds) for emitting DLQ files to GCS.
